items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Brace count via shared lexer; unbound covers reported as warning; untagged-modified text names both remedies, still a STOP, no new exemption code.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: The lexer never raises (unterminated literals fall back to punct tokens); no new failure path.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No external input beyond test source text; no shell or network.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Fixtures call propagate_suite_tags directly and were red before the change (14 failed) and green after.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One lex pass per TS file, linear; bisect for line mapping.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: JSX_SUFFIXES defined once and imported by _file_tags; no second quote tracker; bloat files untouched.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer _suite_tags to manifest invalid_tags to consumers _tag_binding_core and Group D; both probed by tests with real dicts; schema allows the entry (test empty, raw non-empty, reason string).
